about: lint_script.py's own limits for a narration script before recording and the recordings after. The script section holds what log 33 measured; these are the gate's pass marks.

sentence_words_max.source: Design log 35 from log 33 (the rule said as one 28-word sentence; the rewrite's longest is 19)

sentence_words_mean_max.source: Design log 35 from log 33 (long sentences ran fastest: 10-13 words a sentence at 169-176 words a minute; aim about 9)

figures_per_minute_max.unit: spoken figures a minute of speech
figures_per_minute_max.source: Skeptic log 35, calibrated on chapter 2: the recorded script has 37 figures in 252 s of speech (8.8 a minute, too many), the newcomer script 28 in 407 s (4.1 a minute, accepted); 6 lies between

figures_per_minute_look.unit: spoken figures a minute of speech
figures_per_minute_look.source: Skeptic log 35 (a limit of 5-6 a minute)

page_words_a_minute_max.unit: words a minute on one page
page_words_a_minute_max.source: Inventory 'Speaking speed and holds' (flag pages over 170); log 33 (pages at 174-176 carried the most load)

repeated_sentence_words_min.source: lint_script.py; checked on chapter 2's two scripts: at 5 words it finds the newcomer script's rule said on pages 5 and 16 and finds nothing in the recorded script (which said its rule once)

guess_phrases.unit: phrases in a page's last two sentences
guess_phrases.source: Newcomer script (pages 4, 8 and 10 end 'Have a guess.'); lesson 129

stake_words.unit: words that say what is at stake
stake_words.source: lint_script.py; log 33 (the stakes within the first 30 seconds); a person judges

allowed_capitals.source: Inventory 'Script lint before paid recording' (a whitelist such as NZ, GDP)

year_direction_changes_max.unit: changes of direction in the years said
year_direction_changes_max.source: Design log 35 from log 33 (time changed direction 8 times in the recorded chapter)

long_word_letters.source: lint_script.py: without a common-words list, words this long are listed for a person

silence_before_late_word_seconds.source: Inventory 'Multi-word delivery cue, and a late first word' (extend the first-word check to words after a silence over 0.5 s)
